## ltk manage install

Add the pre-tool hook to the most relevant LLM config

```
ltk manage install [flags]
```

### Options

```
      --bin string         the ltk invocation the hook should run (default "ltk")
      --config string      rules file the hook should use ("" to omit) (default ".ltk/config.yaml")
      --engine string      force an engine (default: auto-detect the most relevant)
      --force              overwrite an existing rules file (a .bak backup is written first)
      --global             target the user-level config instead of the project
  -h, --help               help for install
      --no-default-rules   scaffold an empty rules file instead of the shipped defaults
      --print              print the resulting config to stdout instead of writing
      --settings string    explicit settings file path (overrides the engine default)
```
